header:
XHL := (BStore_HeapBase) + (IY - 1) * 0x100, the address of 1-based block IY, without touching the cursor (XIX preserved; the `lda XIX,XIX+0` is a no-op).
BStore_FormatHeap, BStore_AllocBlock_B and BStore_FreeChain_B fetch every block they link this way; BStore_SetCursorBlockAddrFromIY is the same arithmetic plus the store to BStore_CursorBlockAddr. Basis: callers + body + twin.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:108505 `calr sub_F4D935` -- BStore_FormatHeap: IY = 1, then XIY := XHL is the first block it formats
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:108573 `calr sub_F4D935` -- BStore_AllocBlock_B: IY = BStore_FreeHead, then reads the block header (XHL+3)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:108615 `calr sub_F4D935` -- BStore_FreeChain_B: IY = chain head, then reads (XHL+1)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:108686 `ld hl, iy` -- block number from IY
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:108688 `sla xhl, 8` -- (IY-1) * 0x100 (dec 1,XHL on the line before)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:108689 `ld xix, (BStore_HeapBase:16)` -- heap base
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:108691 `add xhl, xix` -- XHL = base + offset; no write to (0x126E)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:159556 `BStore_SetCursorBlockAddrFromIY:` -- twin with the same arithmetic that also stores BStore_CursorBlockAddr

header:
Compacts the block heap: (0x34CE) := BStore_BlockCount; while the lowest free block DE is below the highest used block BC, copies BC into DE (256-byte ldir, source bit 7 cleared) and repoints the neighbour links or, for a chain head / tail, the ten bank copies' directory heads (+0x100) / saved-cursor blocks (+0x7E);
then (0x603452) := used blocks rounded up to 4, x16, and the free list is rebuilt from DE (sub_F4C9B4). BStore_CompactBlocks_Veneer jumps here; SeqFile_PrepareSaveAllBanks and SysExDump_PrepareSequencerData run it before a save / dump. Basis: callers + body.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:107238 `calr sub_F4C811` -- SeqFile_PrepareSaveAllBanks, between workspace -> bank copy and bank copy -> workspace, keeping (0x603452)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:107175 `calr sub_F4C811` -- SysExDump_PrepareSequencerData, same shape
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:106749 `jr sub_F4C811` -- BStore_CompactBlocks_Veneer; its header already says sub_F4C811 should carry BStore_CompactBlocks
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:106806 `calr sub_F4C863` -- find the highest block with header bit 7 set, counting BC down
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:106808 `calr sub_F4C89E` -- find the lowest block with bit 7 clear, counting DE up
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:106815 `calr sub_F4C8DD` -- move one block: sub_F4C8F0 addresses, sub_F4C901 copy, sub_F4C911 / sub_F4C96B relink
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:106976 `ldir85` -- sub_F4C901: 256 bytes (XIX)+ <- (XIY)+, i.e. block BC into block DE; next line clears the source bit 7
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:107009 `lda xiz, (xwa+0x0100)` -- sub_F4C911: per bank 0..9 scans the directory copy at 0x610000 + n*0xC00 + 0x100 and rewrites head BC -> DE
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:107061 `lda xiz, (xwa+126)` -- sub_F4C96B: same for the saved-cursor block words at +0x7E
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:106827 `ld (6304850:24), de` -- (0x603452) := rounded used-block count * 16
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:106829 `calr sub_F4C9B4` -- rebuild BStore_FreeHead / BStore_FreeCount from DE

header:
All-tracks pre-check of MEASURE ERASE / MEASURE DELETE: for each track 1..(0x0CA2) whose saved cursor validates, seeks its chain to the job's first measure (0x0C73) under the master track's time signatures (Seq_FindMasterTrack, BStore_SeekMeasure);
errors 1 and 8 (no data, chain ends first) are skipped, any other returns with BStore_ErrorCode set. MeasureErase_Execute and SongEdit_DeleteMeasures call it (T_F427D0) in all-tracks mode before touching any track. Basis: callers + body.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:136072 `call T_F427D0` -- MeasureErase_Execute, all-tracks (0x0C70 = 0x7F) arm, before the per-track erase loop; a non-zero error aborts
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:135765 `call T_F427D0` -- SongEdit_DeleteMeasures, same place
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:145081 `calr BStore_ValidateSavedCursor` -- track A = (0x0C8E); errors 1/8 skip the track
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:145093 `calr Seq_FindMasterTrack` -- W = master track for time signatures
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:145094 `ld hl, (3187:16)` -- (0x0C90) := (0x0C73), the job's first measure
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:145097 `calr BStore_SeekMeasure` -- walk the track to that measure
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:145101 `jr z, sub_F6452B_Skip3` -- error 8 (and 1 just above) tolerated; others fall to the return

header:
All-tracks pre-check of MEASURE INSERT: (0x0D40) := BStore_FreeCount; for each track that reaches the insert measure (0x0C75), sizes the (0x0C77) measures from (0x0C73) in bytes (sub_F6353E -> BStore_AllocBytesWanted),
converts them to blocks (sub_F647DD -> (0x0D3E)) and subtracts them, returning error 5 when the free blocks run out. MeasureInsert_Execute calls it (T_F427D4) in all-tracks mode before inserting. Basis: caller + body.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:136759 `call T_F427D4` -- MeasureInsert_Execute, after opening the master-part chains in all-tracks mode; non-zero error aborts
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:145115 `ld (3392:16), wa` -- (0x0D40) := BStore_FreeCount
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:145137 `ld hl, (3189:16)` -- first seek: to (0x0C75)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:145152 `ld wa, (3187:16)` -- second seek: to (0x0C73)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:145165 `calr sub_F6353E` -- byte count of (0x0C77) measures into BStore_AllocBytesWanted (stops at tag 0x82 with error 7)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:145174 `calr sub_F647DD` -- (0x0D3E) := blocks needed for those bytes (+10 for a master-part track)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:145178 `ld (BStore_ErrorCode:16), 5` -- (0x0D40) < needed: error 5, else (0x0D40) -= needed

header:
All-tracks pre-check of MEASURE COPY: (0x0D40) := BStore_FreeCount; per track, sizes (0x0C77) measures at the destination (0x0C75) and at the source (0x0C73) (sub_F6353E each) and adds the blocks a smaller copy frees (sub_F64838)
or subtracts the blocks a larger one needs (sub_F647DD), returning error 5 when short. SongEdit_CopyMeasures calls it (T_F427D8) in all-tracks mode before copying. Basis: caller + body + the insert twin.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:137325 `call T_F427D8` -- SongEdit_CopyMeasures, all-tracks arm, before the per-track copy loop
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:145190 `m_and_mi8 MB16, 0x0c8a, 0xf7` -- entry; (0x0D40) := BStore_FreeCount follows
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:145247 `ld wa, (BStore_AllocBytesWanted:16)` -- destination size saved to (0x0D42)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:145262 `calr sub_F6353E` -- source size after the seek to (0x0C73)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:145298 `calr sub_F647DD` -- source larger: blocks needed
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:145302 `ld (BStore_ErrorCode:16), 5` -- not enough free blocks

header:
A := 0 when the latched screen's CYCLE is on -- always on the cycle-play edit screens 0x26 / 0x29, on SEQ PLAY 0x12 / CYCLE PLAY 0x14 when the CYCLE PLAY switch ((0x360B) bit 0) is on, on screens 6 / 8 when the CYCLE RECORD switch (bit 1) is on -- else A := 0xFF.
Seq_RewindOnRequest and Seq_StopWhenTracksEnded take their cycle path on A == 0; CycleRecord_CheckOn is the record-screen-only twin. Basis: callers + body + twin.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94296 `calr sub_F448C6` -- Seq_RewindOnRequest: A == 0 -> locate to the cycle start ((0x3622) on screens 6/8, else (0x361E))
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:95103 `calr sub_F448C6` -- Seq_StopWhenTracksEnded: A == 0 -> keep going while the measure is within the cycle end
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94381 `m_cp_mi8 MB16, UI_ScreenLatch, 0x26` -- 0x26 / 0x29: return with A = 0
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94390 `m_bit 0, MD16, 0x360b` -- screens 0x12 / 0x14: CYCLE PLAY switch
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94399 `m_bit 1, MD16, 0x360b` -- screens 6 / 8: CYCLE RECORD switch
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94402 `ld a, 255:opc` -- otherwise 0xFF

header:
Copies the 3 KiB song workspace 0x603400 into its bank copy 0x610000 + BStore_CurrentBank * 0xC00 (ldirw of 0x600 words, XHL source, XDE destination), all registers saved; unlike BStore_Workspace_SaveToBank it does not stash (0x360C).
First step of SeqFile_PrepareSaveAllBanks and of SysExDump_PrepareSequencerData, whose headers call it "workspace -> its bank copy". Basis: callers + body + twin.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:107229 `calr sub_F4CB0D` -- SeqFile_PrepareSaveAllBanks, first call
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:107174 `calr sub_F4CB0D` -- SysExDump_PrepareSequencerData, before BStore_CompactBlocks
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:107297 `ldw bc, 1536` -- 0x600 words = 0xC00 bytes
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:107298 `ld xhl, 6304768` -- source 0x603400
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:107299 `ld xde, 6356992` -- destination 0x610000 (+ bank * 0xC00 from the mul)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:107302 `ldirw93` -- word ldir (XDE)+ <- (XHL)+

header:
Inverse of BStore_Workspace_CopyToBank: bank copy 0x610000 + BStore_CurrentBank * 0xC00 back into the workspace 0x603400 (0x600 words), registers saved, without BStore_Workspace_LoadFromBank's (0x360C) / free-list restore.
SeqFile_PrepareSaveAllBanks and SysExDump_PrepareSequencerData run it after BStore_CompactBlocks with (0x603452), BStore_FreeHead and BStore_FreeCount pushed around it. Basis: callers + body + twin.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:107242 `calr sub_F4CB34` -- SeqFile_PrepareSaveAllBanks, between the pushes and pops of (0x603452) / free head / free count
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:107179 `calr sub_F4CB34` -- SysExDump_PrepareSequencerData, same
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:107327 `ld xde, 6304768` -- destination 0x603400
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:107328 `ld xhl, 6356992` -- source 0x610000 (+ bank * 0xC00)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:107331 `ldirw93` -- word ldir (XDE)+ <- (XHL)+

header:

The stopped-transport ON arm of SeqTrackKey_UpdateTrackState and of SeqMasterTrack_SwitchOn (T_F40D60); SeqTrack_PlayOffWhileStopped is the OFF twin. Basis: callers + body + twin.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:108904 `calr sub_F4E426` -- SeqTrackKey_UpdateTrackState: track not playing and transport B idle (test at 108899)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:108835 `calr sub_F4E426` -- same routine, REALTIME RECORD: after SeqRecord_DisarmTrack with transport B idle

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:109374 `call T_SeqScreen_QueueTrackRecPlayLabels` -- labels, then T_NoteRouting_RebuildForSong

The running-transport ON arm of SeqTrackKey_UpdateTrackState and of SeqMasterTrack_SwitchOn (T_F40D68); SeqTrack_SwitchPlayOffWhileRunning is the OFF twin. Basis: callers + body + twin.

CycleRecord_CheckOn on UI_ScreenLatch_Previous: A := 0 when the previously latched screen was 6 or 8 and the CYCLE RECORD switch ((0x360B) bit 1) is on, else A := 0xFF.
SeqRecord_EndTake uses it in both arms to choose the cycle-record cleanup (SeqRecord_RestoreCursorBaseline / CycleRecord_FreeRecordChain / SeqRecord_FreeTakeChain2, or T_F40BF0) over the normal one. Basis: caller + body + twin.

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:95809 `calr sub_F44903` -- SeqRecord_EndTake, after a take: A == 0 -> T_F40BF0, else SeqRecord_TerminateTakeTracks

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94426 `ld a, 255:opc` -- otherwise 0xFF

header:
`jrl` to sub_F44C37: when the delayed-locate countdown (0x0C05) bit 7 is armed it cancels it ((0x0C05) := 0), locates every track to the current measure at once (Seq_LocateToCurrentMeasure), releases all track notes, resets the playing-slot controllers (T_F41F18) and runs Seq_ResetPositionOnRequest.
Seq_RewindOnRequest's cycle path sets (0x3552) to the cycle start and (0x0C05) bit 7 just before calling it; the countdown is otherwise run by Seq_DelayedLocateToMeasure_Call. Basis: caller + body (target read).
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94308 `m_set 7, MD16, 0x0c05` -- Seq_RewindOnRequest arms the flag ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94309 `call sub_F4403C` -- ... and calls the veneer (also at 94316)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:93253 `jrl sub_F44C37` -- the veneer
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94882 `m_bit 7, MD16, 0x0c05` -- sub_F44C37: only when armed
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94884 `ld (3077:16), 0` -- countdown cancelled
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94885 `calr Seq_LocateToCurrentMeasure` -- locate now
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94887 `call T_F41F18` -- SeqEvt_ResetPlayingSlotControllers
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94888 `calr sub_F44B2D` -- then the position request (this batch's Seq_ResetPositionOnRequest)

header:
Consumes the position request (0x34D4) bit 4: with no track playing it only clears it and the locate flag ((0x34BB) bit 3); otherwise, unless a song-parameter restore is pending ((0x34D2) bit 0), transport B runs or (0x34D4) bit 6 is set, it clears the bit and
either re-arms at the located position ((0x34BB) bit 3: per-track beat words := TransportB_Beat, TimedEventRing_Discard, sub_F44BE8) or calls Seq_ResetPositionToSongStart. Run every sequencer pass via sub_F44A3B and directly by CycleRecord_RestartPass (T_F40AAC). Basis: callers + body + setter headers.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:103375 `m_or_mi8 MB16, 0x34d4, 0x10` -- CycleRecord_RestartPass sets the request ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:103376 `call T_F40AAC` -- ... and takes it at once
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94608 `calr sub_F44B2D` -- first step of sub_F44A3B, the tail of SeqRecord_HandleTransportBStartStop (every pass)
prom_a/wsa1_prom_a.s:164050 `; ... (0x34D4) bit 4 := 1 -- the request sub_F44B2D takes in the sequencer pass` -- Playback_AcceptMidiStartAndRequestPositionReset header names this consumer
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94743 `m_and_mi8 MB16, 0x34bb, 0xf7` -- no track playing: clear locate flag and the request
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94747 `m_bit 0, MD16, 0x34d2` -- hold while a song-parameter restore is pending
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94753 `m_bit 4, MD16, 0x34d4` -- the request
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94756 `m_bit 3, MD16, 0x34bb` -- located: re-arm at the located beat
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94772 `calr Seq_ResetPositionToSongStart` -- not located: back to the song start

Var20A9_SetBits01, (0x3614) bit 0, then SeqRecord_BeginTake -- the same three steps SeqRecord_StartIfEventQueued takes when a take starts; its trailing (0x34D9) bit-1 test branches to the same ret.
SeqRecord_HandleTransportBStartStop runs it on transport B's just-started edge ((0x345A) bit 1) with record tracks armed and no take begun ((0x3004) = 0). Basis: caller + body + sibling.

header:
Starts a realtime-record take: (0x3759) := the song's default time signature (0x6034D7), (0x3610) := the current measure (1 for the count-in values 0x8001/0x8002), (0x34D2) bit 7 set, take mask (0x3004) := armed mask (0x3000);
for each take track except the cycle-record track, T_F40C74 with (0x0C70) = track + 1; then SongMemory_UpdateFreePercent and sub_F45812. SeqRecord_StartIfEventQueued ("starts the take") and SeqRecord_BeginTakeOnTransportStart call it. Basis: callers + body.

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94678 `calr sub_F45761` -- sub_F44ADA on the transport-B started edge
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:96520 `ld (13840:16), wa` -- (0x3610) := measure; SeqRecord_EndTake restores the measure from it
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:96521 `m_or_mi8 MB16, 0x34d2, 0x80` -- the bit RealtimeRecord_InitOnModeEnter's header says is set when a take starts
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:96523 `ld (12292:16), xwa` -- (0x3004) := (0x3000): the take mask
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:96549 `call T_F40C74` -- per take track, skipped when CycleRecord_CheckIsRecordTrack returns 0
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:96554 `call T_SongMemory_UpdateFreePercent` -- then sub_F45812

header:
